reviewer.observed_identity_reason: Runtime model identity not exposed; requested routing is not observation.
reviewer.blind_phase: Source-only; no owner result/report/code or other review read before freeze

scope.nuisance_domain: theta in [-1,1]; each j_i in [lower_i,upper_i], Cartesian outer box
scope.template: Fixed saved Puchwein2019 template from intake

prerequisites: All inputs finite and dimensionally conforming
Covariance C symmetric positive definite; check Cholesky without jitter
X has rank 2; check whitened numerical rank
lower_i <= upper_i for all nuisance intervals
No covariance pseudoinverse, diagonalization or dropped correlations

equations.W: inverse(C), mathematical definition; implement using solves
equations.ellipsoid_witness: sqrt(q)*V*s/sqrt(s^T V s) for nonzero s; zero for s=0 or q=0

witness_rules.upper_j_i: sign(s^T A[:,i]): positive -> upper_i, negative -> lower_i, zero -> midpoint_i
witness_rules.confidence_endpoint: nuisance support witness plus ellipsoid displacement; report both components
witness_rules.deltaQ_zero_minimum: Convex combination of lower/upper kappa nuisance witnesses giving kappa=0 when interval straddles zero
witness_rules.warning: Different coordinate extrema need not share one nuisance witness

gaussian_coverage_contract.single_coordinate_claim: At least 95 percent coverage for one pre-specified coordinate after nuisance union using q_single
gaussian_coverage_contract.joint2_claim: At least 95 percent coverage for full (b,kappa) after nuisance union using q_joint2
gaussian_coverage_contract.proof: The union contains the true-nuisance Gaussian confidence set for every fixed eta_star in H
not_implied: Exactly 95 percent coverage of the union
A probabilistic prior on the deterministic nuisance box
Statistical sign from a positive deterministic kappa interval alone
Calibrated nuisance-profiled global significance from pointwise DeltaQ
Validity under estimated covariance, selected template, data-dependent bounds or misspecified mean without further argument

acceptance.tolerance_rule: Use scale-aware residuals; report conditioning-driven failures for reviewer interpretation, do not silently relax
checks: GLS normal equations and quadratic completion
Source-covariance Cholesky and whitened design rank 2
Exact deterministic support agrees with endpoint-rule witnesses for +/- axes and an oblique direction
Nested Q difference equals kappa^2/Vkk at identical eta
DeltaQ interval minimum treats zero-crossing as interior minimum
Union support equals deterministic support plus Gaussian radius
Confidence endpoint witnesses attain support and ellipsoid quadratic radius q
q=0 reduces to deterministic set; s=0 support equals zero; fixed nuisance reduces to ellipse
Quantile labels and degrees of freedom distinguish single-coordinate from joint2

phase1_findings: GLS nuisance image is an exact zonotope
Fixed covariance makes confidence union an exact Minkowski sum with one common ellipsoid
A positive deterministic kappa interval alone does not establish statistical sign
The supplied covariance does not by itself establish the Gaussian sampling model
